projects.name: DIR 201 — GM wheat & barley field trial (yield enhancement)
projects.type: GM wheat and barley field trial
projects.desc: Field trial of wheat and barley genetically modified for yield enhancement. One site in Light Regional Council, South Australia, maximum two hectares per year, May 2024 to January 2029. Not permitted in human food or animal feed. Location shown at council level — open the licence page for the site conditions.

projects.name: DIR 186 — GM wheat & barley field trial (yield + abiotic stress)
projects.type: GM wheat and barley field trial
projects.desc: Field trial of wheat and barley genetically modified for yield enhancement and improved abiotic stress tolerance. One site in Light Regional Council, South Australia, maximum two hectares per year, April 2022 to January 2027. Licence conditions require isolation from other wheat and barley, secure transport and storage, and end-of-trial destruction verified by site inspection.

projects.name: DIR 204 — HB4 wheat field trial (environmental stress tolerance)
projects.desc: HB4 wheat, OECD unique identifier IND-ØØ412-7. Carries the HaHB4 gene from sunflower for environmental stress tolerance plus the bar gene as a glufosinate-tolerance selectable marker, introduced by biolistic transformation. Up to ten sites per year across wheat-growing areas of New South Wales, Victoria, South Australia and Western Australia, twenty hectares total per year, August 2024 to December 2029. Already approved for commercial cultivation in Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay. Marker sits at a wheat-belt centroid because the trial is multi-state.

projects.name: DIR 165 — GM wheat field trial (iron uptake & bioavailability)
projects.desc: Wheat genetically modified for altered iron uptake, transport and bioavailability and for enhanced yield, carrying antibiotic and herbicide selectable markers. Sites and dates are not restated on the summary page used to build this record — open the licence for them. Marker parked at the national centroid, so treat the position as unknown rather than approximate.

projects.name: DIR 220 — GM multivalent cat vaccine, commercial supply
projects.desc: Commercial supply of multivalent cat vaccines containing a genetically modified component, for prevention of feline leukaemia virus infection. A commercial-supply licence is national in scope, so there is no site to place — the marker sits at the country centroid. A separate Intervet application for a GM multivalent chicken vaccine was pending at the time this record was written.
